description: Quoridor & Dots-and-Boxes full-featured esports engine with Chess.com review, spectator betting, soundboard emote drops, wall materials, streetwear badges, labyrinth sandbox, headless bot API, Victor Glendenning MCTS, and Dots & Boxes Double-Cross Master Engine.

userStories.title: Wall Material Themes & Streetwear Sticker Badges
userStories.description: As a player, I want to customize wall materials (Caution Tape, Concrete Barrier, Neon Acrylic, Carbon Fiber, Birch Wood) and pawn badges so the board has rich tactile streetwear aesthetics.
acceptanceCriteria: Render 5 distinct wall materials: Birch Wood, Caution Tape (yellow/black diagonal hazard), Concrete Barrier (textured matte gray), Neon Acrylic (cyan/magenta glow), and Brushed Carbon Fiber (dark motorsport weave)
Allow selecting wall material in GameScreen and ProfileScreen
Add streetwear vinyl badge overlays to pawn avatars
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Soundboard & Board Emote Reaction Slap Stamps
userStories.description: As a player or spectator, I want to slap reaction stickers directly onto the board with realistic physical tilt and 3-second auto-fade.
acceptanceCriteria: Soundboard drawer with stickers: GG, 💀, 🧂, 🤡, 🔥, 👑
Stickers slap onto the board surface with random tilt (-15deg to +15deg) and drop shadow
Play tactile slap audio sound effect upon placement
Auto-fade and disappear after 3 seconds
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Interactive Spectator Betting with Virtual Arcade Chips
userStories.description: As a spectator or player, I want to bet virtual arcade chips on turn outcomes (Pawn Advance vs Wall Placement) with dynamic odds and instant payouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Virtual chip wallet with persistent balance (starts at 500 chips)
Betting buttons for 'Pawn Advance (1.6x)' and 'Wall Placement (2.2x)'
Settles bet immediately when the turn resolves and plays win/loss chirp
Spectator toggle mode available in HUD
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Full Match History Recording & Game Review Integration
userStories.description: As a player, I want complete turn-by-turn move recording during gameplay so I can trigger Chess.com style game review and view animated replay cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Record every move (pawn or wall) in moveHistory with boardStateBefore
Display 'REVIEW MATCH (!!)' button on Victory and Draw modals
Launch GameReviewModal with CAPS accuracy, !! brilliant moves, win probability timeline scrubber, and animated replay card
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Custom Labyrinth Sandbox with Solvability BFS & 6-Char Share Codes
userStories.description: As a puzzle creator, I want a freeform sandbox to place custom pawns, lock walls, validate solvability via bi-directional BFS, and generate 6-character share codes.
acceptanceCriteria: SandboxScreen with freeform pawn placement, wall locking, and clearing
Live solvability indicator: green if both pawns have valid path to their goal row, red with warning if locked
Generates 6-character base64-encoded share code that can be copied and imported
Directly test-play the puzzle in sandbox mode
Navigation entry from MatchHubScreen and BottomDock
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Headless Bot API & Automated Arena Simulator
userStories.description: As a developer or AI enthusiast, I want a headless bot API and automated arena screen to test algorithms at 100x speed with path metrics and win-rate telemetry.
acceptanceCriteria: headlessBotApi.ts providing pure logic game runner and mock WebSocket bot interface
BotArenaScreen supporting automated bot duels (Apprentice vs Tactician vs Grandmaster or Custom script)
Controls for 1x, 10x, and 100x instant duel speed
Telemetry charts: win rate, average turns, detour efficiency, walls remaining
Accessible from MatchHubScreen developer tools
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Dots and Boxes Engine, Double-Cross Strategy & Victor Glendenning MCTS
userStories.description: Full Dots and Boxes implementation with 2-4 players, 4 computer difficulties, 4 board sizes, 5 themes, auto-save, Double-Cross strategy, Victor Glendenning MCTS engine, and Supabase keep-alive.
acceptanceCriteria: Up to 4 player Dots and Boxes with custom Human/AI configurations
4 computer difficulties (Easy, Medium, Hard, Master with Double-Cross chain sacrifice)
Board sizes: 2x2 (Blitz), 3x3 (Classic), 4x4 (Tactical), 5x5 (Master)
5 board themes: Streetwear Neon, Blueprint Tech, Chalkboard Slate, Sunset Aurora, Woodcraft Vintage
Turn timer primary toggle (ON / OFF) in HUD
Victor Glendenning MCTS engine with PUCT progressive bias
Supabase keep-alive heartbeat service preventing project sleep
All 137 unit tests pass in verify-game-logic.ts
npm run build completes with 0 errors
userStories.notes: 137 / 137 tests passing, build clean, running on localhost:5173.
